findings.claim: The final solved-run record is not bound to the final lab bytes. It records LAB_BUNDLE.sha256 digest 8685d088de02adf161fab85525c9ae11140e5b876b0937afa8e4e71c4764d3f0, but a fresh authoring/tools/pep export-lab at exact clean commit 8193f763c50d79359f179717bf0b731e7de28327 produces c90f6e1034ad832bd6d7c67e95a0c89473bc2be7de591ae20a56fef23ff60df7. The stale receipt therefore cannot establish that its claimed solved run exercised the final CSS reader and dynamic-boundary tests, even though this independent recheck separately observed the final public suite behaving correctly.
findings.recommendation: Repeat the private solved run against an export of exact final lab bytes, record the actual current LAB_BUNDLE.sha256 digest and run identity, regenerate the module lock, and obtain a focused same-role recheck. Also harden the repository lab gate so a solved-run digest mismatch fails rather than accepting the presence of a digest-shaped statement.

items.note: Resolved on exact commit 8193f763c50d79359f179717bf0b731e7de28327. The six learner tasks retain outcome-first Where, Outcome and Done when prompts with optional partial hints, while the public failures name the missing rendered or source outcome without printing a completed rule. An independently authored scratch completion passed 7/0, the shipped starter failed 0/7, all 11 supported valid routes passed, and all 21 established invalid routes failed without a disclosed solution.
